watches.name: STAIB MESH
watches.description: DESCRIPTION Produced by Hermann Staib, a fourth-generation family business founded in 1922 in Pforzheim, Germany. This highly polished mesh band is thin and comfortable, draping slim on the wrist. Crafted from 316L stainless-steel mesh wire, it comes equipped with a convenient fold-over clasp and quick-release spring bars for secure, tool-free swaps. DIMENSIONS Size: 110mm x 90mm suitable for wrists from 13.5 cm to 19.5 cm (5.3" to 7.7") Lug Width: 20mm to 20mm (buckle)
